findings.title: Consolidation deletes journal rows without saving their replacement
findings.evidence: JournalEntry.load returns only the ID (26-27), merge discards payloads (30-32), save is pass (34-35), then DELETE executes at 51. database.core.connect uses isolation_level=None.
findings.trigger: Call autoconsolidate against a nonempty journal table.
findings.impact: Every selected original entry is deleted with no replacement persisted; autocommit makes deletion durable even before the final commit.

findings.title: YouTube URL and output directory are interpolated into shell commands
findings.evidence: run_cmd uses subprocess.run(shell=True) at 9; URL is interpolated into double quoted command strings at 17, 36 and 42; argv flows directly to fetch_youtube_audit at 53-55.
findings.trigger: Pass a URL or output directory containing shell command substitution or a quote followed by shell syntax.
findings.impact: The shell executes injected commands with the invoking account privileges. Double quotes do not suppress command substitution.

findings.title: Persistent retry deadlines use a clock that resets at reboot
findings.evidence: Worker compares next_retry_at to time.monotonic at 43-54 and stores it at 77; producer pulmones.py:87 stores time.monotonic()+delay in SQLite.
findings.trigger: Reboot after queueing a task when the previous uptime was long.
findings.impact: Persisted deadlines remain in the previous boot clock domain and can postpone retries for the old uptime duration.

findings.title: Fetching retry work does not claim rows atomically
findings.evidence: SELECT at 46-55 has no lease/status update; execution happens at 110 and deletion only at 113 via a separate connection.
findings.trigger: Run two PulmonesWorker processes on the same database and fetch the same ripe batch before either deletes it.
findings.impact: Both workers execute the same queued side effect; there is no ownership claim or deduplication in this worker.

findings.title: Appliance installer copies from a crate-local target directory in a workspace
findings.evidence: REPO_DIR resolves to crates/eridu-infer at 60-61; cargo build executes there at 68 but cp expects crates/eridu-infer/target/release/eridu-infer at 69. Cargo.toml defines the root workspace; .cargo/config.toml has no target-dir override.
findings.trigger: Run provisioning from a clean checkout with cargo available and no crate-local prebuilt binary or CARGO_TARGET_DIR override.
findings.impact: Cargo places the workspace artifact in root target; cp fails under set -e after system power/network settings have already been changed.

findings.title: Master ledger explicitly selects NORMAL durability despite FULL requirement
findings.evidence: BFTMasterLedgerWAL sets PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL at 112, immediately below comments requiring FULL for a master ledger at 110-111; .babylon60rules requires synchronous FULL.
findings.trigger: Use this ledger class for committed transactions and suffer OS/power failure before WAL synchronization.
findings.impact: The configured durability is weaker than the class contract and committed recent transactions may be lost; no crash experiment was run.

findings.title: Telemetry stop cancels the worker without draining pending events
findings.evidence: stop docstring promises draining at 55 but cancels at 57, awaits the cancelled worker and clears it at 62; it never awaits queue.join or consumes remaining items.
findings.trigger: Ingest events and immediately stop before the background worker has consumed them.
findings.impact: Queued events remain unprocessed when stop returns, contrary to the shutdown contract.

findings.title: Attestation test passes even for blocked or failed results
findings.evidence: The test branches only print status and errors at 24-29; it has no assertion about status, receipt or signature anywhere.
findings.trigger: run_chaos_monad returns a failure/error dictionary without raising.
findings.impact: The test succeeds and can give a false regression signal for a broken attestation pipeline.

hypotheses.observation: HardwareAuthority.authorize signs only payload_digest; intent_id, action_name and target_resource are not cryptographically bound by this adapter.
hypotheses.hypothesis: A consumer that treats this attestation as authority for the entire CanonicalIntent could substitute action/resource while retaining the digest.
hypotheses.limitation: Targeted src search found no non-test authorize consumer; no execution bypass established.

hypotheses.observation: Server binds to all interfaces and /api/metrics returns full ledger rows without authentication.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Ledger data may be exposed to other hosts where network access permits it.
hypotheses.limitation: Data sensitivity and deployment network controls were not established.
